facticity: Confirm snapshot identity, source hashes, and human approval provenance.
static: Validate schemas and reject every simplified verification entrypoint.
unit: Exercise planner, snapshot, approval, stale approval, and no-light decisions.
redteam: Attempt service approval, hash mismatch, stale approval, and partial-domain bypass.
e2e: Run the complete plan-to-blocked-to-approved case gate.
sensory: Review that the case contract and approval decision are understandable before execution.

facticity: Confirm installed runtime, package, browser, provider, permission, and fingerprint facts.
static: Inspect runtime lock, adapter boundaries, and no-fallback code paths.
unit: Test installer, doctor, runner identity, retry identity, and oracle decisions.
redteam: Remove components, corrupt locks, mutate retry fingerprints, and submit model-only PASS.
e2e: Run managed-runtime and registered-adapter contracts from the repository.
sensory: Review doctor and blocker output for exact, actionable operator guidance.

facticity: Confirm evidence identity, hashes, size, producer, references, readings, and gate source bindings.
static: Validate all V2 contracts, cross-references, aggregation ownership, and append-only boundaries.
unit: Test EvidenceStore, integrity, readings, not_applicable, aggregation, freshness, and rerun scope.
redteam: Probe missing, forged, empty, stale, tampered, unrecognized, and manual-green inputs.
sensory: Review domain and gate explanations for traceable evidence and concrete rerun reasons.

facticity: Confirm every attempt and repair link preserves immutable failure evidence and source identities.
static: Inspect ownership boundaries between Verification, Development, and Core.
unit: Test classification, retry, retest, regression, closure, reopen, and no-progress transitions.
redteam: Attempt to overwrite failures, misclassify retries, close before regression, or loop without progress.
e2e: Run failure packet creation through development repair handoff, retest, regression, and closure.
sensory: Review that failure and repair history clearly distinguishes FLAKY and PASS AFTER FIX.

facticity: Confirm every displayed value and evidence link originates from the validated report model.
static: Inspect shared components, semantic markup, escaping, CSP, and no-inline-secret constraints.
unit: Test report model and renderer behavior for every supported state.
redteam: Inject markup and secrets, break evidence paths, and edit generated HTML verdicts.
e2e: Render and navigate all three pages using real Playwright browsers.
sensory: Review desktop, mobile, keyboard, print, readability, overlap, and status hierarchy.

facticity: Confirm migration inventory, backups, receipts, hashes, validation, and retained failures.
static: Inspect migration schema, path safety, mutation boundary, and rollback contract.
unit: Test valid, incomplete, malformed, missing-evidence, and rollback fixtures.
redteam: Attempt to convert weak V1 green into V2 PASS or mutate production paths from fixtures.
e2e: Run dry-run, migration, validation, receipt, and rollback lifecycle.
sensory: Review that operator output distinguishes migrated, blocked, failed, and rollback states.

facticity: Confirm kernel, schema, fixture, wrapper, generated artifact, and host receipt identities.
static: Detect duplicated verdict logic and verify thin adapter and service boundaries.
unit: Run shared kernel fixtures and host-specific adapter contracts.
redteam: Mutate locks, schemas, blockers, wrappers, fixtures, and discovery manifests.
e2e: Run Codex, Claude Code, and CodeFree-O discovery, doctor, fixture, and compatibility flows.
sensory: Review host diagnostics for consistent terminology and actionable drift details.

facticity: Confirm release and archive bind snapshot, readings, evidence, versions, freshness, reports, migration, and hosts.
static: Inspect operations gates, safe filesystem boundaries, and transactional archive contracts.
unit: Test gate recomputation, missing inputs, tampering, receipt binding, archive commit, and rollback.
redteam: Attempt HTML-green forgery, copied summaries, stale evidence, host mismatch, and filesystem races.
e2e: Run complete release proof and transactional archive fixtures.
sensory: Review release and archive verdicts for exact blockers, provenance, and next actions.
